clauses.title: The writer iterates on focused validation before the guard and receives pinned literals verbatim
requires: the writer runs the focused validation commands itself and proceeds to the guard only when they pass
the guarded focused validation stays the single terminal check
carries that literal verbatim from its source rather than describing it (CL-D64)

clauses.title: Writer pre-guard fixtures pin the prose and the record
requires: the writer iterates on focused validation before the guard and receives pinned literals verbatim
CL-D64 records the writer duty without relaxing the terminal rule

clauses.title: CL-D64 names the path it governs
requires: #248 later scoped the writer-runs-validation rule above to the prose path (https://github.com/tetsuh/pi-tidd-agents/issues/248#issuecomment-6054013937): on the packaged driver path (CL-D96) the writer does not run the validation commands itself, and after the edit the driver's `batch` runs them once, as the guarded focused validation, which stays the single terminal check.
